text:
## Template 3: Failed Direct Debit Alert  
**Trigger:** Direct Debit rejected (insufficient funds, etc.)  
```
FirstUK: Direct Debit of £[amount] to [biller] failed on [date].
Reason: [insufficient funds/other]. Add funds to retry.
Call 0800-555-2265.
```  
*Character count: ~125*

raw_entities.name: Failed Direct Debit Alert
raw_entities.description: An SMS or push notification template triggered when a Direct Debit payment fails due to insufficient funds or other reasons. The template notifies the customer of the failed payment, the biller, the amount, the failure reason, and directs them to add funds or contact support.
